name: SA Net
summary: Early Adelaide dialup/hosting ISP (SA Net Pty Ltd, sanet.com.au); defunct by early 2000s (ELECTRONIC ACCESSORIES AUSTRALIA PTY. LIMITED (NAMED ON THE SA NET REGISTRATION PAGE AS 'EASY ACCESS AUSTRALIA PTY LTD'), ACN 010 834 492).

events.details: Defunct; domain redirected to webmail then parked. Domain was a BoldWeb server-default stub by Mar 2001 and webmail-only by 2003, so the c. 2001 absorption proposal beats the current c. 2003.

refs.label: Real SA Net homepage, Dec 1996 (Jul 1997 already a 'Welcome to the Internet' placeholder).
By 2 Mar 2001 the domain sat unconfigured on BoldWeb's Adelaide server - the ISP site was gone (acquired/absorbed by BoldWeb).
By Feb 2003 only a webmail login remained - webmail-only = dead (prior evidence, confirmed consistent with 2001/2002 301s).
